name: phalange
description: One MCP server for Phalange's three public-record verticals: restaurant health inspections (live API), nursing-home records and public-school data (dated extracts published by each line).
long_description: The umbrella Phalange server. Restaurant tools proxy the live API at eat.phalangeai.com (9 US metros; a compliance lookup that answers with coverage_status — not_covered means no data, never 'clean'). Nursing-home and school tools read versioned data extracts that each Phalange line publishes on its own domain; the server verifies each extract's manifest (schema version + sha256) on first use and dates every answer with a data_snapshot block (extract version, generation time, source vintage). Nursing records carry CMS's own star ratings with their as-of date; school records carry each state's own published proficiency measures — no composite score or ranking is computed anywhere.

tools.name: restaurant_compliance_lookup
tools.description: Restaurant compliance lookup by name + address: coverage status, latest inspection, violations, closure status

tools.name: restaurant_search
tools.description: Search restaurant venues in one metro by name

tools.name: restaurant_venue_detail
tools.description: One venue's inspection history and latest violation lines

tools.name: restaurant_risk_summary
tools.description: Per-metro inspection/failure aggregates for a time window

tools.name: nursing_facility_lookup
tools.description: Nursing home by name: identity, status, CMS star ratings with as-of, latest survey, stored penalty totals — dated by its extract snapshot

tools.name: nursing_search
tools.description: Browse nursing homes by state, city, or ZIP in the dated extract

tools.name: nursing_state_summary
tools.description: Per-state aggregates computed from the nursing extract itself, dated by its snapshot

tools.name: schools_school_lookup
tools.description: Public school by name (MA + TX): identity, enrollment, and the state's own published proficiency percentages — dated by its extract snapshot

tools.name: schools_search
tools.description: Browse schools by state, district, city, or level in the dated extract

tools.name: schools_compare
tools.description: 2–4 schools side by side on published figures only — no composite, no ranking, no winner
